rule: Publish stable seams for independent testers: exported service classes with constructor-injected repository and policy, stable OpenAPI operationIds, and data-testid attributes on form controls.
bad_example: export default function handler(req, res) { const db = new Pool(); ... } // nothing injectable
good_example: export class GpaCalculationService { constructor({ repository, gradingPolicy }) { ... } }
provenance: C3 research team reviewed card (2026-10-20); paraphrases Michael Feathers, Working Effectively with Legacy Code (seam concept)
